C1.worst_defect: On the phone the top bar shows only "VendurePOS", "Docs" and "Live demo", so "For cashiers: At the till", the page my staff need, is only reachable from the hero button or after opening Docs. Otherwise "Point of sale for Vendure" plus "Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0" and "Your own store needs the plugin on your Vendure server first" tells me in five seconds what this is and what I need.

C2.worst_defect: The Changelog lists only plugin releases (0.3.0, 0.2.0, 0.1.0). The till my staff actually use is labelled "till app version 0.1.0, built 20 Nov 2026 from vendurepos/app commit 7bd49a1", but it has no change history, so I can't tell what changed at the counter since yesterday. The limits are stated honestly elsewhere: refunds go to the Vendure Dashboard on 0.3.0, no cash drawer, desktop Chrome only.

C3.worst_defect: The quick start is complete for my developer: steps 1-9, a "Check it worked" section and Troubleshoot. But it carries a collapsed legacy block, "If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app", which is noise for a new install. The connect step also needs a manual role fix: "On plugin 0.3.0 the vendurepos-pos-till role has no ReadOrder: add it yourself, or the till sells but its order history is refused". That is an extra trap before staff can sell tomorrow.

C4.worst_defect: My question is what happens when the end-of-day closure doesn't reach my store. The answer is spread across developer language: "When the store refuses a till update (the register's open, close, cash movements or closure), the till does not send it again, except a closure refused for its number… None of those register records reach your Vendure store from this till, so keep the printed Z reports". Troubleshooting adds errorCode names such as register_session_already_open and register_closure_number_invalid. At the till also says "If the difference is over this till's limit, Manager approval asks for the manager's name" but never says where that limit is set.

C5.worst_defect: In At the till, the cashier-sheet and closure screenshots sit as small centred cards with wide empty margins either side. On a 1440 px desktop the till detail I'm meant to recognise is hard to read. Otherwise the type, code blocks, sidebar and dark mode are clean and consistent.

C6.worst_defect: On the phone the Changelog's inline code path "packages/vendure-plugin/CHANGELOG.md" breaks mid-chip across lines. Long code identifiers such as "authOptions.tokenMethod" and the migration class names make Plugin setup choppy on a phone between customers. Nothing overflows, and the home comparison table stacks properly.

C7.worst_defect: Small: the mobile LCP is 2.3-2.4 s on / and /docs/quick-start, and Lighthouse flags unused JavaScript. Everything else is solid: Lighthouse 98/100/100/100, CLS 0, no images missing alt text, no horizontal overflow, a real 404 that links every docs page, JSON-LD, llms.txt and llms-full.txt, a sitemap with 10 URLs, an OG image, and /api/search?query=offline returning relevant hits.

overall_worst.defect: A shop owner can't find a plain-language answer to "my closure or cash movement didn't reach Vendure, what now?". The answer is in developer terms: "till update", "refused for its number", the errorCodes register_session_already_open and register_closure_number_invalid. It is split across Limitations and Troubleshooting rather than sitting in At the till's close-the-day section. The manager-approval "till's limit" is never located either.
overall_worst.fix: Add a short box under At the till's "Close the day" section headed "If the closure doesn't reach your store": keep the printed Z report, what the till shows, and who to call (your developer). Link Troubleshooting for the errorCodes. Also say where the over/short limit for manager approval is set.
